name: Password Reset
summary: Passive labelled password-recovery request shell composed from canonical Form, Input, Button, and optional confirmed Alert feedback while targets own the security and request lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native section labelled by the required visible title.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional passive decorative illustration omitted when blank.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible recovery-request heading that labels the root.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Complete canonical Form slot required for request composition and omitted from provider-confirmed composition.

anatomy.name: success
anatomy.description: Optional canonical success Alert inserted only from confirmed target state.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic narrow profile with a private maximum measure.

states.name: request
states.description: Valid request rendering with required title, guidance, and complete canonical Form composition.

states.name: confirmedFeedback
states.description: Provider-confirmed target composition containing canonical Alert and no request Form; target selection does not create a public U2 state property.

behavior.name: labelledRegion
behavior.description: The native section is programmatically named by its non-empty visible heading; no password-reset ARIA role or composite keyboard model is introduced.

behavior.name: resetRequest
behavior.description: Canonical Form, Input, and Button preserve native identifier editing, autofill, constraint validation, named submission, keyboard activation, and reset while the target owns the request.

behavior.name: successFeedback
attributes: tabindex="-1" when target focus recovery is required
behavior.description: Provider-confirmed visible feedback replaces the request Form, composes canonical Alert, uses polite dynamic status semantics, and becomes a target focus destination only when removing the submitter would strand focus.

behavior.name: targetLifecycle
behavior.description: The target owns mutually exclusive request or confirmed composition, errors, uniform response timing, abuse protection, delivery, tokens, focus, retry, routes, and analytics. U2 adds no neutral runtime or public state machine.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Localized and indivisible content wraps within the component without page-level horizontal overflow.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional passive decorative illustration; it is hidden from accessibility APIs and supplies no state or name.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible recovery-request title that labels the section.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Non-empty visible request guidance that does not reveal account existence.

properties.name: form
properties.unsetBehavior: Valid only when a non-empty successMessage supplies the mutually exclusive provider-confirmed composition; otherwise omit the complete shell.
properties.description: Complete canonical Form composition required for the target-controlled request presentation and omitted from confirmed presentation.

properties.name: successMessage
properties.unsetBehavior: Render the request Form composition; when both form and successMessage are absent, omit the complete shell.
properties.description: Non-empty provider-confirmed feedback composed through canonical Alert instead of the request Form; target composition selection is not a public success state.

accessibility: Name the native section from its non-empty visible heading and omit the complete renderer when required title, guidance, or Form composition is absent.
Use canonical Input with a visible label, submitted name, native email type, autocomplete=email, required semantics, and target-connected text errors.
Preserve native Form submission, constraint validation, keyboard activation, reset, and focus behavior rather than replacing them with a custom keyboard model.
Compose provider-confirmed feedback through canonical Alert instead of the request Form; use polite dynamic status semantics and move focus only when replacement would otherwise strand it.
Keep the optional illustration decorative and do not rely on icon, color, or feedback tint alone.
Use generic request and feedback copy, uniform response timing, and target-owned rate limiting so the surface does not reveal whether an account exists.
Allow long localized and unbroken content to wrap without clipping or page-level horizontal overflow.

Keep request Form and provider-confirmed Alert mutually exclusive while leaving composition selection, provider truth, and transition lifecycle target-owned rather than adding a public success boolean.

web.notes: Labelled passive shell implemented in Account CSS and composed from canonical Form, Input, Button, and optional Alert with no U2 runtime.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 current customer accounts are passwordless and intentionally omit U2. Classic recover_customer_password and the distinct reset_customer_password step require a separately versioned compatibility adapter; no automatic fallback is allowed.

react.notes: Compose native dependency controls and external request state; U2 does not own a recovery state machine.
